course_points.n: Bear left onto bike path along river
Continue straight onto Rue du Mont Suret
Bear left onto Place de l'Abreuvoir
Turn left onto Quai de Verdun
Bear left and directly bear right; keep river at your left
Turn slight left onto Rue du Halage
Turn right onto Rue Paul Chapelle
Turn left onto Rue de Verdun, D 1
At roundabout, take exit 3 onto Rue Gambetta, D 18e1
Turn right onto Rue du Château
Turn right onto Avenue des Victoires
Turn left onto Rue du Maréchal Foch
Keep left onto Rue de la Prairie
